sections.title: Current Scene 04 — what is in Read Story

items.label: Sequence
items.note: Part A: Kavya–Deepu exit from introduction → Shivani challenges Karan/Aman → lift/corridor buildup → B01 Karan initiates first handhold/pull → B02 Aman takes other hand/pull → B03 Aman kisses Shivani's neck → B04 close chest contact → apology and separation → Shivani says 'Arre, utho dono. items.label: Source fidelity
items.note: B01–B04 and the apology are author-supplied text. The pre-B01 duplicate handholds were suppressed in the UI version of buildup only; original document paragraphs remain archived. No prose rewording is approved by this reference.

items.label: Scene finish versus episode finish
items.note: The corridor encounter is complete through flat entry; Scene 05–07 household/Om/Rohan follow-up remain unwritten in Episode 04A.

items.label: Deferred squeeze/pressure beat
items.note: Old ledger B05 was the breast-squeeze action label, actor not assigned. Author specifically moved it out of this Scene 04 encounter for potential future use. Future episode, actor/receiver, consent, pacing and setting are not assigned; no automatic reintroduction.

items.label: Other earlier unsubmitted action-ledger candidates
items.note: Exact historical labels from the earlier 12-beat handoff: B05 breast squeeze (actor unassigned; explicitly reserved as future-only); B06 buttock slap by Karan; B07 buttock slap by Aman; B08 deliberate pelvis-to-body pressing/movement with both twins; B09 close-body press with both twins. These were proposed in an older handoff, are absent from the latest author-provided B01–B04→apology prose, and are NOT approved future events. Only B05 has explicit future-intent status; do not silently reintroduce the others.

items.label: No auto-import
items.note: A Future Idea is not approved story canon. Revisit only after the author selects a specific future scene and approves its role in the plot.

items.label: Earlier duration proposal superseded
items.note: The earlier idea of 30–60 seconds for each physical beat, roughly 5 minutes encounter plus 3 minutes apology, was a proposed schedule, not a final locked duration. B04→apology is shorter than the original escalation plan; do not pad it just to match eight minutes.

items.label: Repetition risk
items.note: B01–B04 repeatedly refer to breathing, held hands, the dupatta, short pauses and proximity. Review for repeated descriptions before any author-approved line edit. A slow-burn effect should come from changing stakes, reactions and meaningful choices, not repeated mechanics.

items.label: Karan versus Aman
items.note: Karan initiates B01, then Aman carries B02–B04. Check whether Karan's much quieter presence is deliberate or needs an approved character beat. Do not invent additional actions.

items.label: Shivani POV
items.note: Track her own decisions and reactions beat by beat. Her later 'I liked it' does not retroactively establish consent for all earlier contact; reaction and willingness should be clear at each escalation where relevant.

sections.title: Two exact continuity issues — text not silently changed

items.label: B04 handoff
items.note: The supplied B04 exit still says 'Ready for B05', but the next supplied text begins apology/separation. Preserve source until author approves a transition edit; do not invent B05.

items.label: Apology posture
items.note: The line 'Arre, utho dono' implies the twins should rise, but no preceding crouching/kneeling/lowering action is in the supplied apology. Resolve whether to add a plausible preceding action or revise that dialogue, only with author approval.

items.label: Where final prose lives
items.note: Published author-confirmed scenes appear only in main Society Wives → Read Story → Episode 04A. Planning shows completed/published indexing and unfinished scenes, not duplicated prose. Keep source plot files as an archival record, not active published content.

items.note: Discuss plot, escalation, pacing and continuity before writing or publishing. Preserve author/Grok supplied manuscript verbatim unless an exact adjustment is approved. Keep approval and change-log status visible.
